name: @gjsify/example-dom-adwaita-gallery-nativescript
description: The probe behind the website gallery's NativeScript XML tab: it loads every generated app/views/*.xml through NativeScript's own Builder on a real Android device and asserts the view tree the Builder built — element class, every attribute read back typed, and every child resolved through its parent's own slot accessor. Sources are GENERATED by scripts/generate-adwaita-nativescript-templates.mjs from scripts/adwaita-gallery-ns-templates.mjs, so the bytes a reader copies off the website are the bytes this app inflated.

scripts.prepare:android: npm run sync:theme && nativescript prepare android --no-hmr --disable-npm-install
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:theme && nativescript build android --no-hmr --disable-npm-install
scripts.run:android: npm run sync:theme && nativescript run android --no-hmr --disable-npm-install
scripts.probe:android: npm run sync:theme && node scripts/run-on-device.mjs android
